title: Hot drive add and remove and live device renumber
body: Drives can be turned on and off and have their device number changed at runtime without restarting the emulator.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A drive attached to a running session answers on the bus with no restart.
A detached drive's pull contributions are removed and line states recompute.
A drive's device number (8 to 11) can be changed at runtime and it answers the new number.
